E2_definition.mechanical_interpretation: minimize the worse joint-by-movement-branch relative RMS
E2_definition.name: BRANCH_BALANCED_RELATIVE_RMS

decision_rationale: E2 creates a real simulated ordering interaction and a robust transfer penalty when the exceptional Leg 4 oracle is transferred to other legs. However, four of five legs retain the exact reference oracle, the cohort-optimal common reference has zero regret on those four and only 0.071 percent relative regret on Leg 4, 228 candidates are universally within 0.5 percent, and mean common regret is no larger than the fixed perturbation variability. The systems therefore still primarily support a shared common trajectory rather than a sufficiently strong sequential personalization target.

robustness_aware_necessity.fixed_perturbation_definition: two fixed waveform cases at 0.25% of reference joint peak, plus two deterministic half-rate sample grids
